title: windows-explorer-native-integration

windows_image_checkpoint.network_scope: Nonlocal normal-token TCP/HTTP succeed; ordinary AppContainer no-network connect denies 10013; LPAC stops earlier with Winsock10107/WinHTTP12004. Do not equate the stages.

tests.scope: Original Explorer scope: four isolated loader cases passed; one desktop availability scenario failed. Repository regressions and the separately recorded windows_image_checkpoint are not added to this original count. Explorer G1 was not retried.

risks: No usable Explorer client or installer; root activation cause remains undetermined.
Direct loading success is not target Explorer loader evidence.
Bounded event query and three mitigation policies do not cover every system restriction.
Windows Job CPU time is periodically checked and measured overshoot is documented; no hard three-second promise
LPAC network initialization failure is distinct from ordinary AppContainer direct LAN denial; untested raw-network or other COM classes are not asserted safe
blocked_by: Desktop authorization was renewed; the latest attempt again failed GetCursorPos 0x80070005 and contemporaneous Session2 was WTSDisconnected. Await an actually usable RDP state, not another permission question.
Actual Explorer loader/COM observation and G1 remain missing; queried package/AppContainer and explicit Shell policies did not establish a root cause.
G2/G3/G4 and bounded Host-to-Shell projection remain unimplemented/unproven.
Agreed Windows native matrix is submitted; broader Provider/network/COM/platform and release gates remain independent and are not closed by this task.
